text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: The twelve pounds you've lost is significant; are you experiencing any difficulty swallowing, heartburn, or a sensation of food getting stuck? Have you noticed any blood in your stool or vomit?

text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed. To keep my notes clear, please give only one final answer and keep it to a single direct conclusion.

text: The description of a "fixed," painless, supraclavicular lymph node alongside significant weight loss, night sweats, and abdominal symptoms is highly concerning for malignancy.
